contract: Pure composition of one-input/one-output declared interfaces, reusable as an outer interface; execution uses the unchanged core/operator Contract.
limits: Descriptors do not bind functions or prove implementations honor declarations.
No graph routing, fan-out, delivery, process, persistence or state serialization guarantee.

grounding.claim: The pinned Cure compiler checks the pure descriptor decision source before emitting BEAM.
Named positive/negative descriptor checks, ABI translation and source audit pass; finite scenarios, not universal proofs.
A legal nested Cure composition compiles and executes; the named Bool-to-Int mismatch fails compilation. Existing core/operator laws remain dependency evidence.
Relies on pinned Cure type checking, structural equality, nominal String, Result and record erasure; compiler soundness is not locally proved.
Callers keep schema IDs truthful and state/function ownership consistent; descriptors do not verify implementations or payloads.

telemetry.contract: Pure declaration checks emit no observations; the caller owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Descriptor fields are intrinsic operands; there are no ambient settings or selectable compatibility modes.

control.contract: No independent runtime lifecycle or operational commands.
